news.words: Aiyuk (knee) was placed on the active/PUP list by the 49ers on Friday. He isn't expected to be available for training camp as he recovers from a torn ACL and MCL in his right knee sustained in October.
While no official timetable is set, midseason appears to be the earliest that Aiyuk could return to the field. The team stated on multiple occasions that Aiyuk's recovery has gone well.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (Kyle Shanahan, via Vic Tafur, The Athletic)
news.words: The 49ers moved Aiyuk (knee) to the reserve/PUP list Tuesday, a procedural move: coach Kyle Shanahan has circled Week 6 as a possible date for his 2025 debut. He can technically return as early as Week 5.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (John Lynch, via David Lombardi, SFStandard.com)
news.words: 49ers GM John Lynch said Thursday that Aiyuk (knee, PUP) is "not close" to returning. Lombardi believes a Week 6 return is not realistic, as he is still working to hit various markers in his recovery.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (Kyle Shanahan, via Nick Wagoner, ESPN, and David Lombardi)
news.words: Shanahan said Monday that Aiyuk is getting "closer and closer" to being able to practice, but there's no specific timeline. "I always look around Week 10, but I'm not putting an exact date on it."

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (John Lynch, via David Lombardi, SFStandard.com)
news.words: Lynch said Thursday that he has both hope and "evidence" that Aiyuk (knee) will soon be ready to make his 2025 debut. Until he is cleared to practice, a target date is hard to pinpoint.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (Kyle Shanahan, via David Lombardi, SFStandard.com)
news.words: Shanahan said Friday that the 49ers may designate Aiyuk (knee) to return from the reserve/PUP list next week, opening a 21-day practice window. The team currently is in "week-to-week mode" with him.

On whether Aiyuk will play this year: "I'm pretty confident that he is going to eventually. At least open up his practice window. We talk about it being week-to-week right now, so still waiting until he is ready."

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (Kyle Shanahan, via Nick Wagoner, ESPN)
news.words: Shanahan said Monday that the 49ers don't intend to open Aiyuk's (knee) practice window this week. A return is unlikely this coming Sunday and probably for at least a few more weeks after that.
